name: skybreaker
description: Surgebinders who command Gravitation and Division. Stern and unyielding, Skybreakers seek justice above all — even when it demands judgment without mercy.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Skybreaker swears to follow the law, placing it above personal judgment or emotion. Justice is external, not internal.
quotes: I will seek justice, to be just in all things.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: The Skybreaker binds themselves to a specific code or legal structure, following it to the letter, even when it conflicts with their own desires.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: The Skybreaker becomes the law — no longer just a follower, but an arbiter who can pass judgment when existing structures fail.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: The Skybreaker accepts full moral responsibility for enforcing justice — acknowledging their role in shaping what justice means.
quotes: I will choose who to save — and who to kill — and bear the weight of that choice.
